open_spaces_details.description: The entire site is designated as Green Belt. The site is currently in use as an Indoor Sports facility (its previous use was an outdoor sports pitch). However, the current permission is temporary and due to expire this year. Therefore, the proposals will technically be a loss of Green Belt land. Please refer to PDAS for further info.
open_spaces_details.open_space_type: Outdoor sports facilities incl. school playing fields

description: Retention of the existing dome and ancillary plant previously approved under planning ref 00608/E/P34 as a permanent permission.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Applicant Response to GLA Stage 1 Comments, Drainage Design Note (0046469, Rev.P01, dated 13/10/2023), Energy and Sustainability Statement (XXXX-BHE-XX-XX-XX-X-XXXX, 0046439, Rev.P01, dated 13/10/2023), Fire Risk Assessment (dated 25/10/2023) and Transport - GLA Response (0046439-BHE-2318-01, Rev.P02, dated 27/11/2023). Received 07/12/2023Drawings 20_00(Rev.A), 20_01(Rev.A), 20_02(Rev.A), 20_03(Rev.A), 20_05(Rev.A), two unnumbered location/site plans and Planning, Design & Access Statement (August 2022). Received 17/10/2022. Cranford Plan 1 received 23/04/2025. Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 2 - Within six months of this permission, full details (including manufacturers' specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities that accord with the West London Cycle Parking Guidance (for no fewer than 57 bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved expanded facilities shall be fully implemented and made available in line with a timeframe to be agreed as part of submissions to discharge this condition. The approved facilities shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity for use atall times without obstruction.Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 3 - Any fixed external plant shall be designed and installed to ensure that noise emanating from such plant is at least 10dB below the background noise levels when measured from the nearest sensitive receptors. All plant shall be installed in accordance with the approved plans, and all existing plant shall also be reviewed to ensure that it meets these noise limits. No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To protect the amenities of existing and future residents and ensure that the development provides a high quality design.

Condition : 4 - Within six months of this permission, a Car Park Management Plan for all parking provisions within the wider Cranford College site specified on the blue site line shown on 'Cranford Plan 1' shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority which includes details of:� college car park usage during evenings and weekends (via a parking survey);� how the car parking areas will be laid out (included disabled spaces);� how Blue Badge / accessible bays and electric charging bays will be increased to meet London Plan standards; and� how the car park will be managed and by whom, including enforcement arrangements.The car parking areas shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and ensure minimal disruption of traffic in the locality.

Condition : 5 - Within three years of this permission, a Travel Plan shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall describe the means by which residents, visitors and users of the development shall be encouraged to travel to the site by means other than the private car and reduce single occupancy car journeys. The Plan as approved shall be implemented in accordance with a timeframe to be agreed within this Plan, and shall be monitored and reviewed by an overseeing body thereafter (details of which shall be described in the plan) on an annual basis, with a copy of that annual review and action plan arising shall be submitted to the local planning authority. The measures described in the action plan shall be implemented in the time period identified.Reason: In order to ensure all occupiers for the development are aware of all means of travel in the vicinity of the application site and to seek to prevent unnecessary vehicular movements to and from the site.
Condition : 6 - The uses and buildings hereby approved shall not operate outside the hours of 08:00-22:00 Monday to Sunday.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residential neighbours.

Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Energy and Sustainability Statement hereby approved, with the energy demand reduction measures included within this Statement to be implemented from the date of this permission and maintained thereafter in perpetuity.Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.
